description: This file defines the XmlScanner class, which provides mechanisms for scanning and identifying risky XML elements, particularly for preventing XXE/XEE security vulnerabilities when parsing XML files used in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for checking encoding, disabling entity loaders, and scanning XML content or files for dangerous constructs.

classes.name: XmlScanner
classes.description: Provides security scanning capabilities for XML content to prevent XXE and XEE attacks by detecting dangerous XML constructs such as <!ENTITY> and verifying encoding validity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an XmlScanner instance with a default or custom pattern to identify risky XML elements and sets up shutdown registration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new XmlScanner instance tailored for a specific Reader instance, choosing the appropriate pattern based on whether the reader is HTML or not.

methods.name: threadSafeLibxmlDisableEntityLoaderAvailability
methods.description: Checks whether the current PHP environment supports thread-safe libxml disable entity loader functionality based on PHP version and release.

methods.name: disableEntityLoaderCheck
methods.description: Disables libxml entity loader if PHP version is below 8.0.0 and stores the previous state for later restoration.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Restores libxml entity loader state if it was changed during cleanup.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures cleanup by restoring libxml entity loader state when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: setAdditionalCallback
methods.description: Sets an optional callback to be invoked after scanning the XML content.

methods.name: forceString
methods.description: Converts a given argument to a string if it isn't already one.

methods.name: toUtf8
methods.description: Converts the XML string to UTF-8 encoding, checking for UTF-7 and other encodings, and removing BOMs if present.

methods.name: findCharSet
methods.description: Attempts to determine the character set used in the XML, supporting distinct encodings and throwing exceptions for unsupported types.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Scans the provided XML string for use of <!ENTITY> to prevent XXE/XEE attacks; converts encoding and applies callback if set.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Reads an XML file and scans its contents for risky elements using the scan() method.
